Callout.Name: Birth Imminent
Callout.Message: Woman in labour, no time for the hospital.

Script.Line: It started on the way here and it has not stopped since.
Two minutes apart. I have been counting them.
I am not going anywhere. This is happening now, in this room.

Callout.Patient: Is she all right? Tell me she is all right.

Lines.Approach: There is no time for the hospital and she knows it. You are the closest thing to a professional.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
